name: The Hall of Treasures
description: A hall of taxidermied extinct animals in Luneau.

timeline.summary: In the Hall of Treasures Vivien sees hundreds of taxidermied extinct species and wants to see it all gone, understanding Bolas for a moment.
timeline.quote: For one terrible moment, the Planeswalker could understand Nicol Bolas, the death of Skalla, the end of everything she'd known and loved.
